themes.description: 7 champion buffs, 5 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: The Black Rose got some adjustments... and balance changes, run! Structured changes across 25 entities this patch.

champions.name: Aatrox
champions.tldr: Damage health ratio reduced to 4–8% of the target's maximum health from 4–12%.; Sweetspot bonus damage increased to 70% from 60%.
champions.gameplayImpact: Aatrox was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Damage health ratio
lines.note: Damage health ratio reduced to 4–8% of the target's maximum health from 4–12%.

lines.note: Third cast sweetspot base damage increased to 10*1.7*1.5–70*1.7*1.5 from 10*1.6*1.5–70*1.6*1.5.

lines.label: Maximum base damage
lines.note: Maximum base damage increased to 63.75–446.25 from 60–420.
